stages.text: Board your courier at the dock (step on the portal, press G) and leave Kestrel Reach.

one_way_message.text: First segment decodes: 'If you're reading this, you're at the station - good. Don't file a flight plan.' Board your courier at the dock (step on the portal, press G).

stages.text: The note names a dead relay in the Tessellate system - open the star map, select it, and jump.

one_way_message.text: Next segment decodes, in Elian's own words: 'Tessellate. The old relay station - it still holds air, and someone still lives in it. Ask them about the survey.' Open the star map (1), select Tessellate, and jump (V).

stages.text: Land at the Tessellate relay station and find the archivist who knew Elian.

one_way_message.text: The relay's on a slow tumble but the dock still lights up - line up on the station and press G to land, then find whoever's keeping the logs.

stages.text: The note's last line points past the edge - open the star map, select the Verge, and jump.

one_way_message.text: Final segment, and it isn't a place: 'If it's still talking when you get there, it isn't me anymore. Come anyway. The Verge - the moon with the settlement. I'll have left the light on.'

stages.text: Fly to the settled moon in the Verge system, land at its pad, and find Elian Marr.

one_way_message.text: There's one settled moon in the Verge and one lit pad on it. Fly up to the moon and press G to land, then find Elian.
